verses.text: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when he fled from Saul into the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy, for in You my soul takes refuge. In the shadow of Your wings I will take shelter until the danger has passed.

xrefs.text: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
How precious is Your loving devotion, O God, that the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Your wings!
For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

verses.text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.

xrefs.text: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
equip you with every good thing to do His will. And may He accomplish in us what is pleasing in His sight through Jesus Christ, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
O LORD, You will establish peace for us. For all that we have accomplished, You have done for us.
Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.

verses.text: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.

xrefs.text: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
Then Peter came to himself and said, “Now I know for sure that the Lord has sent His angel and rescued me from Herod’s grasp and from everything the Jewish people were anticipating.
May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.

verses.text: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts— with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

xrefs.text: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
there is a generation whose teeth are swords and whose jaws are knives, devouring the oppressed from the earth and the needy from among men.
How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
Speaking rashly is like a piercing sword, but the tongue of the wise brings healing.

verses.text: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

xrefs.text: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
“Yet as surely as I live and as surely as the whole earth is filled with the glory of the LORD,
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.

verses.text: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah

xrefs.text: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
He who leads the upright along the path of evil will fall into his own pit, but the blameless will inherit what is good.
He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
The godly man has perished from the earth; there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; they hunt one another with a net.
For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.

verses.text: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.

xrefs.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.
Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.

verses.text: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

xrefs.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
‘Awake, awake, O Deborah! Awake, awake, sing a song! Arise, O Barak, and take hold of your captives, O son of Abinoam!’
Awake, awake, clothe yourself with strength, O Zion! Put on your garments of splendor, O Jerusalem, holy city! For the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer enter you.

verses.text: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.

xrefs.text: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
so that the Gentiles may glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: “Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles; I will sing hymns to Your name.”
Why do the nations rage and the peoples plot in vain?

verses.text: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.

xrefs.text: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
“For a brief moment I forsook you, but with great compassion I will bring you back.
Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?

and they sang the song of God’s servant Moses and of the Lamb: “Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty! Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
